_doc: Tabbie's sound-effects library: reuse these before making new ones (no ElevenLabs needed to use them). Each sound has 1-3 variants (<name>_<n>.mp3 in this folder); the prompt says what it sounds like. In Remotion: <Sfx name="whoosh_soft" atSec={1.2} /> from src/audio. New sounds need ElevenLabs.
style: clean, minimal, premium Apple-style product video sound design, high fidelity, no music, no voice
